description: A Perl script for managing downloads in OpenWrt/LEDE build environment, including mirror selection, hash verification, and download execution.

methods.name: localmirrors
methods.description: Reads local mirror URLs from a file and environment variables.

methods.name: projectsmirrors
methods.description: Loads project-specific mirror URLs from a JSON file.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Checks if a program exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: hash_cmd
methods.description: Determines the appropriate hash command based on checksum length.

methods.name: tool_present
methods.description: Checks if a download tool (curl, wget, aria2c) is available.

methods.name: select_tool
methods.description: Selects the download tool to use based on availability and environment variables.

methods.name: download_cmd
methods.description: Constructs the command line for downloading files with the selected tool.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Performs the download from a mirror, with hash verification and local copy handling.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary files related to the download.
